title: Frailty Assessment Guidance
recommendation_blocks: Use frailty screening to trigger comprehensive geriatric assessment rather than leaving risk scoring as a standalone output.
Escalate quickly when frailty coexists with weight loss, recurrent falls, delirium, or medication burden.
Tie frailty assessment to mobility, nutrition, medication review, and caregiver planning.

title: Fall Risk Assessment Guidance
recommendation_blocks: Treat recurrent falls as a multi-factor syndrome requiring medication review, mobility assessment, and orthostatic evaluation.
Escalate high-risk patients for supervised prevention interventions rather than giving generic safety advice alone.
Reassess after each fall-related intervention so risk reduction is measured over time.

title: Chronic Disease Registry Risk Stratification Guidance
recommendation_blocks: Risk-stratify registry patients using disease burden, missed follow-up, and preventable-utilization signals rather than diagnosis labels alone.
Upgrade outreach urgency when uncontrolled disease, overdue review, or care-gap clustering is present.
Document why AI risk overrides a submitted manual risk level so registry changes stay auditable.

title: Antenatal Visit Risk Assessment Guidance
recommendation_blocks: Escalate ANC visits when hypertensive disease, severe anemia, infection, fetal compromise, or danger signs are present.
Use gestational age, fetal status, blood pressure, and proteinuria together rather than isolated thresholds.
Link maternal risk flags to immediate action items, alerting, and follow-up timing.
